root_cause: The modal's click handler closes the dialog for any click inside the overlay because it uses `closest` to find the close trigger, which matches the overlay ancestor for all descendant clicks. This causes the dialog to close when the checkbox receives a click event (triggered by Space key).
repair_strategy: Modify the click handler to only close when the clicked element itself has the close trigger attribute (i.e., event.target === closeTarget), allowing clicks on the overlay background or close button to close, but not clicks on interactive elements inside the dialog.
expected_accessibility_effect: Checkbox can be toggled via Space key without closing the dialog, preserving keyboard operability (WCAG 2.1.1) and focus management (WCAG 2.4.3).
functional_risks: Minimal; only changes click dismissal logic. Could affect closing when clicking on overlay if the overlay is not the direct target (but it is). Ensure close button still works.
verification_requirements: Run the existing journey test; ensure Space on checkbox toggles and dialog stays open.
Verify Tab traps focus inside the dialog.
Verify clicking overlay background closes the dialog.
Verify clicking close button closes the dialog.
